messages:
IncBot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected in ap-southeast-1 gateway cluster. 1m error rate = 7.2% (baseline 0.6%). Triggered paging to on-call.
Evan (on-call): reading it now — seeing lots of 502/504 across the region. @Samir K can you join? I'm starting triage.
Samir K: on it. first pass: gateway logs show increased downstream timeouts to runtime nodes, and a spike in connection resets. Dumping a couple of quick stats now.
Samir K: `curl -s 'https://edge-apac-redwood/internal/metrics' | jq '.gateway.errors | {5xx_1m, latency_p95}'`
Samir K: output: {"5xx_1m": 7.2, "latency_p95": 1.2}
Carla V: confirmed from NYC prod console: traffic to ap-southeast has higher tail latencies. A handful of high-traffic customers show increased failed requests. Support, please flag impacted customers.
Support-Bot: Noted. Creating incident ticket INC-2026-420 and adding customers: AcmeCorp, BeaconHealth, Travelly. Preparing template for status update.
Evan (on-call): immediate mitigation options: 1) failover a subset of traffic to us-east for affected routes; 2) scale gateway frontends / increase connection pool; 3) enable degraded-mode routing to cached-model variant. Which do we prefer for lowest blast radius?
James - EngRuntime: if downstream runtime nodes are timing out, failing over at the gateway layer to another region is safest. We have model parity in us-east. Need to ensure KV cache warm-up. Also we should disable cross-region caching TTL enforcement to avoid cold-start storms.
Samir K: running quick health check of runtime pods in ap-southeast: `kubectl get pods -n runtime -l region=ap-southeast -o wide` -> many pods OOMKilled? Some CPU spikes.
Samir K: attaching a snippet of the pod status (truncated):
```
NAME                                    READY   STATUS    RESTARTS
runtime-ml-0-9f4                         1/1     Running   0
runtime-ml-1-4a2                         0/1     OOMKilled 3
runtime-ml-2-bc3                         1/1     Running   1
```
Carla V: OOMKilled on a subset — could be a bad quantized kernel landing? Any recent config changes in apac cluster?
James - EngRuntime: Not that I'm aware of in infra yesterday. But there was a model kernel rollout last night for a perf patch. Querying the rollout logs.
Priya S: paging infra-team too: @Carla V @James - EngRuntime please confirm if we should revert kernel rollout.
Carla V: recommend pausing rollout and reverting to previous kernel on ap-southeast until we validate. That should reduce OOMs if correlated.
Samir K: I'll trigger quick rollback for runtime pool in ap-southeast, start with 20% of nodes to reduce risk.`
Samir K: `deploy-bot: revert rollout runtime-kernel v2.1 -> v2.0 region=ap-southeast --percentage=20`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: runtime-kernel v2.1 -> v2.0 (20%) — ETA ~3m
Evan (on-call): while rollback runs, let's start controlled failover for traffic-heavy routes to us-east. James, can you update routing policy for model-route: /v1/generate with weight shift 30% -> us-east?
James - EngRuntime: doing it now. `routectl set-weight --route /v1/generate --from ap-southeast --to us-east --weight 30`
James - EngRuntime: applied. Monitoring error rate and downstream latencies.
Samir K: rollback reports first batch healthy; nodes that reverted show normal memory profiles again.
Evan (on-call): error rate down from 7.2% to 4.1% in 2m after weight shift + partial rollback. Still above baseline.
Maya - Product: heads-up — customers on support list are noticing 5xx in dashboards. We should prepare a short status message and ETA. Support-Bot can you draft a blurb we can post?
Support-Bot: Draft: "We detected elevated errors in ap-southeast-1 impacting a subset of API requests. We are performing targeted failover and rolling back a recent runtime kernel change. Next update in 15 minutes."
Priya S: also notify account execs for AcmeCorp & BeaconHealth — risk of API failures. @Carla V can you add SLO impact estimate?
Carla V: rough SLO hit: at current rate ~4.1% over last 5m translates to ~2.3% customer-facing error window. We'll give a clearer figure in the next update.
Evan (on-call): paging follow-up — @Samir K if rollback and failover don't get us <1% in next 10m, escalate to full regional failover and open bridge.
Samir K: agree. I'm kicking an increase in gateway frontend replicas as a buffer: `kubectl scale deployment gateway-frontends -n edge --replicas=8 -l region=ap-southeast`
IncBot: Action: replicas scaled from 5 -> 8 for gateway-frontends in ap-southeast (triggered by Evan)
Samir K: gateway CPU trending down, error rate now 1.8% — almost back in range. A few customers still see intermittent 504s, likely due to a couple of old nodes not yet cycled.
Evan (on-call): I'm going to take a 20m break for an urgent page at home; Samir will lead mitigation. Handoff: Samir, you're primary. If situation degrades, escalate to oncall-sre-2.
Samir K: taking lead. I'll keep updates in this thread. @James - EngRuntime can you keep an eye on cache warm-up in us-east? We should avoid cold-start surge.
James - EngRuntime: monitoring KV cache fill rates; initiating proactive pre-warm for the shifted routes.
Maya - Product: prepping customer-facing note for Status page. ETA 12m.
Support-Bot: Status update posted: "Investigating elevated errors in ap-southeast; targeted mitigation in progress. Some customers may experience intermittent 5xx. Next update in 15 minutes." Link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-420
Carla V: short-term postmortem note: log correlation suggests kernel change + a couple of older nodes caused OOM cascades. We'll include timeline + mitigation steps in postmortem.
Samir K: error rate stabilized at 0.9% after full replica cycle and rollback completion. Keeping traffic split weight at 20% to us-east until cluster verified for another 30m.
Evan (on-call): back online — thanks @Samir K. Good job on the handoff. Any remaining customer impact?
Support-Bot: Alerting list cleared. Open tickets: INC-2026-420 (active), CUSTOMER-ACME (high), CUSTOMER-BEACON (medium). Support has sent proactive messages to impacted customers.
Carla V: scheduling post-incident meeting 1hr from now to capture action items: rollback safeguards, kernel canary improvements, and improved runbook steps for cross-region failover.
Maya - Product: request to include communication cadence in postmortem. Prioritize customers with SLAs for outreach.
Samir K: final note: root_cause preliminary = kernel rollout v2.1 introduced memory regression in certain quantized op path on older GPU images causing OOMs -> gateway downstream timeouts -> elevated 5xx. Mitigation = rollback, scale frontends, partial traffic shift, cache pre-warm. Postmortem will have exact timelines & metrics.
Evan (on-call): closing the on-call shift handoff: incident contained. Samir to remain primary for the next 30m. If anything spikes, ping oncall-sre-2 and open bridge.
IncBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity -> P2 (reduced). Resolved? false. Next update scheduled in 30m. :white_check_mark:"
